description: Reduced 4-actor diagnostic semantic contract for the untimed Odd-Even ring: 2 logical Ping roles and 2 logical Pong roles form one directed alternating 4-node recurrent ring carrying one logical protocol token.

semantic_backend.reason: The benchmark's defining behavior is positive recurrence after asynchronous neighbor initialization. Counterexample-only traces are insufficient; the evaluator must inspect reachable initialization states and a stable recurrent state-space component.

semantic_scope.main_scenario: The four actors are configured as ping1 -> pong2 -> ping3 -> pong4 -> ping1, and only ping1 receives the initial Start. This is a reduced-size diagnostic variant of the original 20-actor benchmark.
semantic_scope.important_limitation: The source PingActor also defines behavior for receiving Ping, but the intended initialized OddEvenRingApp protocol routes Pong messages to Ping actors and Ping messages to Pong actors. Therefore the PingActor-on-Ping branch is characterized by the Scala unit oracle but is not a mandatory state-space property when it is unreachable in the main scenario.

initialization.asynchrony: SetNeighbor messages are sent to different actors before Start, without a global initialization barrier.
initialization.evaluation_rule: Do not require the first protocol round to close to the raw initial state. Separate setup/warm-up from the stable initialized recurrent component.
initialization.representation_policy: A Rebeca translation may preserve SetNeighbor explicitly or compile the fixed final topology into static knownrebec bindings. Both are acceptable if the initialized observable ring is equivalent.

invariants: Each logical protocol role has exactly one protocol successor.
Each logical protocol role has exactly one protocol predecessor.
The four roles form one connected directed cycle.
Ping and Pong roles alternate around the cycle.

observable_protocol.startup: Exactly one logical Ping role initiates the protocol by sending the Ping-type message to its successor.
observable_protocol.ping_role_behavior: In the reachable main scenario, a logical Ping role consumes a Pong-type protocol message and emits exactly one Ping-type protocol message to its configured successor.
observable_protocol.pong_role_behavior: A logical Pong role consumes a Ping-type protocol message and emits exactly one Pong-type protocol message to its configured successor. This successor is the configured next Ping, not necessarily the incoming sender.
observable_protocol.message_sequence: Ping, Pong, Ping, Pong, ... around all 20 ring edges.
observable_protocol.recurrence: After setup/warm-up, the initialized protocol repeatedly traverses the same 4-role directed alternating ring.
observable_protocol.token_conservation: In the stable recurrent component there is exactly one logical Ping/Pong protocol message in flight among the four logical roles.

representation_policy.names: Target class, rebec, variable, and message-server names are not semantic identifiers.
representation_policy.class_sharing: All Ping roles may share one reactive class and all Pong roles may share one reactive class.
representation_policy.message_encoding: Ping/Pong may be renamed or structurally encoded, provided the evaluator can observe two alternating protocol message roles and the same routing/multiplicity.
representation_policy.target_topology: Static knownrebec bindings are acceptable even though the Akka source uses SetNeighbor, because the main program assigns one fixed final ring topology.

excluded_from_equivalence: exact SetNeighbor implementation when final initialized topology is preserved
unreachable external message scenarios outside OddEvenRingApp
global ordering among independent initialization messages before stable operation

state_space_limit_policy.principle: A directly observed contradiction is FAIL. Missing positive recurrence evidence is NOT_OBSERVED when the exported graph is insufficient or truncated; it must not be silently converted into a model defect.

tests.description: The unique startup Ping role emits exactly one Ping-type protocol message to its ring successor.
Each logical Ping role observed in steady operation consumes Pong-type input and emits exactly one Ping-type message to its successor.
Each logical Pong role consumes Ping-type input and emits exactly one Pong-type message to its configured successor.
No steady protocol transition duplicates or fans out the logical token.
Four logical protocol roles are observed: two Ping roles and two Pong roles.
Every role has exactly one successor and predecessor and all four roles form one directed cycle.
Ping and Pong logical roles alternate on every ring edge.
Ping-role sends use one protocol message kind and Pong-role sends use the other kind.
Exactly one Ping role initiates protocol traffic without first consuming a recurrent Ping/Pong token.
Inside stable initialized operation, a connected witness traverses all four roles in ring order and returns to the same observable protocol-token projection.
The initialized protocol exposes two Ping and two Pong roles; auxiliary setup rebecs are ignored.
Initial execution reaches the stable recurrent ring after zero or more setup/warm-up transitions.
A reachable cyclic SCC contains recurrent protocol progress for all four logical roles.
Every state in the selected stable recurrent component contains exactly one logical Ping/Pong protocol token among the four roles.
The selected recurrent component contains no terminal protocol state.
Cardinality, initialized topology, alternating routing, unique startup, full-round recurrence, and single-token conservation are all preserved.
